profile: Focused on modern web technologies and standards, I work regularly with HTML, PHP, JavaScript, CSS, Liquid (Shopify), and WebComponents, while learning React (Next.js) in my spare time through courses. I have also had the opportunity to use Java, Android Studio, and SQL across various professional and academic projects.

highlights.text: Front-end development across 20 e-commerce websites (PHP, SCSS) and a shared back-office built on a Bootstrap template (Twig macros): performance optimisations, bug fixes, and feature development
Contribution to the back-office and web application of UniFy (OMS & Store App)
Design and development (Java, native Android) of a bridge connecting a printer to the in-store sales application, deployed on ~400 terminals
Built the Shopify ↔ UniFy integration app: checkout UI, storefront, and admin UI
Created a WebComponents library (order, return, and stock widgets) embeddable by UniFy's retail clients
Created an Android application for the Buddy robot (emotive robot), controllable via JavaScript
Complete overhaul of the Vittascience website (Bootstrap 5) with internationalisation (right-to-left reading direction) and a custom theme
Maintenance and development of the open-source project OpenSTEAM-LMS for several clients (Texas Instruments, AREN Éducation...)
Full rewrite of an ASP.NET site to PHP in 6 months (MaClasseTI.fr)
Mentoring of an apprentice (Bac+2) over 1 year
Integration of Adobe XD mockups on OpenSTEAM-LMS and the Vittascience website, with a theme system via CSS variables
Implementation of the new store design, drawing on UX/UI skills acquired on the Classroom platform
Integration of the new homepage alongside various landing pages
Improved site accessibility (light/dark themes, typography options for dyslexic/visually impaired users)
Integration of Adobe XD mockups for a Learning Management System feature
Implementation of dynamic visuals and new modules for an Arduino & BBC micro:bit simulator
Created 6 pages dedicated to content from Hatier exercise booklets
Discovered how an IT environment is set up in a company (IT support role), visited the PSA Datacenter in Achères, and used Microsoft Office frequently
